resources.string: PulseSpan reads Sleep, Heart Rate Variability (HRV), Resting Heart Rate, Heart Rate, Steps, Active Calories, and Exercise sessions synced from your Google Fitbit tracker via Android Health Connect. All biometric calculations run locally on your device to compute your daily Sleep, Recovery, Strain, and Longevity Scores. PulseSpan never sells your health data. If you enable Gemini AI Coaching, only summarized daily scores and trends are used to generate personalized readiness guidance.
